login.title: Welcome aboard, Cadet!

phase.mission_prep.blurb: Starts at check-in — get ready for take-off

phase.journey_home.blurb: Look back and earn Homeward Bound
phase.touchdownNote: Finish Flight Academy with the Touchdown! mission to explore your destination.
phase.scanNote: Scan your boarding pass to start this journey. Mission Prep begins at check-in.
home.topRank: Top rank reached — Young Aviation Ambassador!
home.startFlightNote: Scan your boarding pass to check in. Mission Prep starts right away!
home.scanToUnlock: Scan a boarding pass to unlock
home.leaveBody: You keep every star, badge and journal entry. This journey just stops here and you can start a new flight.
home.introBody: When you get your boarding pass, scan it here to check in. Your first mission starts straight away. No flight today? Try the Arcade!
sheet.contest: Choose a photo, drawing or story and a contest category. A parent needs to allow contest entries in Settings.
sheet.activity.prompt: Play the game to complete this mission.
sheet.photo.prompt: Take a photo and save it in your Flight Journal to complete this mission.
sheet.land.prompt: Has the plane landed and stopped at the gate? Tap to stamp your passport!
sheet.complete.prompt: Finish your journey to earn Homeward Bound and add it to your passport.
sheet.auto.prompt: Done when you built your cadet.
reward.checkedInMsg: Mission Prep has started. Your first mission is ready!
reward.stampMsg: A new stamp is in your passport. Destination Discovery is unlocked!
reward.journeyMsg: You flew the whole mission. What an aviator!
play.aiChip: Written by AI for your age and route
play.matchPrompt: Tap one on the left, then its partner on the right.
play.boardingClosed: 📣 Boarding is closed — here’s the answer
play.checkWhenLand: Check it when you land — it’s saved in your journey.
play.mapPrompt: Tap the map where you think {city} is.
play.saveError: Something went wrong saving that. Please try again.
scan.title: Scan your boarding pass
scan.cameraNote: Point the camera at your paper or mobile boarding pass
scan.hold: Hold the barcode inside the frame. Ask a grown-up to help!
scan.notFound: We couldn’t find {flight}. Try another flight number, or the demo pass.
scan.cameraError: We couldn’t open the camera. You can type your flight number instead.
scan.checkInError: Check-in didn’t work. Please try again.
arcade.surpriseNote: Jump into a random mission you haven’t played yet
arcade.aiFor: Written for a {band} who dreams of being a {tracks}.
arcade.aiForFlight: Written for a {band} who dreams of being a {tracks}, about your flight to {city}.
arcade.aiOff: (AI is off right now, so you’ll get our best hand-made quiz.)
arcade.tapToFlip: Tap a card to flip it
journal.title: Flight Journal
journal.subtitle: Photos, drawings and stories from every trip
journal.focus.photo: Take a photo and save it
journal.focus.meal: Snap your meal, describe it and give it stars
journal.focus.contest: Add a photo or a story and pick a contest category
journal.caption: Write a caption…
journal.private: Photos stay private to your family’s account.
journal.storyPlaceholder: Tell the story of your trip in a few sentences…
journal.parentNeeded: A parent needs to allow contest entries in Settings → Parent zone.
journal.empty: No memories yet — take your first photo!
journal.readError: We couldn’t read that photo. Try another one.
journal.saveError: Saving didn’t work. Please try again.
passport.noStamps: Your first stamp arrives when your plane lands. ✈️
passport.noRoutes: Scan a boarding pass to draw your first route.
passport.noAircraft: Fly your first mission to start your aircraft collection.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tracksNote: Your tracks add special missions to your journey.
settings.gateWrong: Not quite — ask a grown-up to help.
settings.allowContestHint: Lets your cadet enter My Destination Story. Entries are judged by category, never by likes.
settings.allowSharingHint: Lets you share the journey summary with family.
settings.privacyNote: Photos are private to this account and can be deleted from the Journal at any time. No face recognition is used.
stage.title: Flight status
stage.getting_ready.note: Time to head to the airport in about {time}.
stage.on_board.soon: Landing soon — get ready for arrival!
stage.landed.note: Welcome to {city}! Destination missions are open.
stage.touchdownNote: Tap Touchdown to stamp your passport
funFacts.title: Fun facts
funFacts.homeNote: Flip a card and learn something new — they get harder as you go!
funFacts.deckNote: Tap a card to flip it. When you turn it back, a new fun fact takes its place.
funFacts.allRead: You’ve read every fun fact. Amazing!
funFacts.noneYet: Facts you flip are saved here with the date.
arcade.rightNow.getting_ready: Warm up for your trip with these games.
arcade.rightNow.at_airport: You’re at the airport — these games are perfect here!
arcade.rightNow.on_board: Games to play while you fly.
settings.demoNoFlight: Start a flight to try the demo stage switch.
settings.demoStageHint: Pretend to be at another point in the trip to preview what cadets see. Choose “Real time” to follow the real flight times again.
journal.everydayNote: No flight right now — memories are saved as everyday notes.
journal.howFeel: How do you feel right now?
journalPrompt.pre_flight.0: What are you most excited about on this trip?
journalPrompt.pre_flight.1: What did you pack that you couldn’t leave behind?
journalPrompt.pre_flight.2: Which planes can you see from the window?
journalPrompt.pre_flight.3: What is the busiest thing you can see at the airport?
journalPrompt.pre_flight.4: What do you think your destination will be like?
journalPrompt.in_flight.0: What do the clouds look like right now?
journalPrompt.in_flight.1: What can you hear on the plane?
journalPrompt.in_flight.2: What was the best part of take-off?
journalPrompt.in_flight.3: Describe your meal like a food critic.
journalPrompt.in_flight.4: If you were the captain, what would you announce?
journalPrompt.post_flight.0: What was the first thing you noticed after landing?
journalPrompt.post_flight.1: Which smells, sounds or colours are different here?
journalPrompt.post_flight.2: What new word did you learn today?
journalPrompt.post_flight.3: What was your favourite moment so far?
journalPrompt.post_flight.4: What would you tell a friend about this place?
journalPrompt.everyday.0: Where would you love to fly next?
journalPrompt.everyday.1: What’s your favourite thing about planes?
